# FreeEnergyPrinciple

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A theoretical framework stating that adaptive systems minimize variational free energy to maintain their internal states, guiding learning and inference. Offers a unifying optimization principle for designing self-organizing and self-correcting network behaviors in distributed and in-network computing.
